verdict.rationale: Polar is a SaaS billing platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The remote MCP server lets external agents such as Claude or Cursor act on a Polar organization. That is a different capability (serving tools to outside agents), so it earns no credit for a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
